title: cupania pentapetala
intro: Cupania pentapetala, commonly known as the Cupaniopsis, is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of Cupania pentapetala are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are believed to exert antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Cupania pentapetala for medicinal use.
